scope.violations.why: An out-of-scope action is an incident, not a metric. This floor never moves.

scope.false_blocks.why: A gate that passes by refusing in-scope work has failed differently. Attack success and task success are measured together.

scope.cases.why: The adversarial corpus may grow but never shrink — deleting a case is how a suite silently stops testing.

router.worst_waste_ratio.why: At 80% blocker density the matrix is 80% blocked; the router must not exceed the density it was handed.

coverage.invariants_held.why: Every Assay metric is expressed against the coverage matrix; a drift here moves them all at once without any of them looking wrong.

grader.classifications_held.why: Every headline number comes from grade(); a misclassification there is wrong in a way no individual result looks wrong.

continuity.resumption_fidelity.why: A cold restart must recover everything persisted. Anything less means the agent redoes settled work.

ledger.detector_cases_passed.why: The integrity detector must keep catching every planted defect. A detector that stops detecting passes silently otherwise.
